channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Shutdown of Hormuz Strait raises fears of soaring oil prices
item.description: Consumers are set to pay higher prices, but US producers could benefit, analysts say.

item.title: Iran to do ‘utmost’ to protect China’s citizens amid US-Israel attacks: FM
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi holds calls with China's Wang Yi amid Israeli-US attacks on Iran.

item.title: UAE resumes limited flights amid travel chaos across Middle East
item.description: Dubai's airport authority says it authorised a limited number of flights as hundreds of thousands remain stranded.

item.title: Who is Ali Larijani, the Iranian official promising a ‘lesson’ to the US?
item.description: Ali Larijani is often viewed as a pragmatist and has an important role following the killing of Khamenei.

item.title: As bombing continues, Israel’s war aim in Iran becomes clear: Regime change
item.description: Israel aims for regime change in Iran, but may not care as much about whether the transition is smooth.

item.title: Nepal’s Gen Z threw out old parties. Will it vote for them in key election?
item.description: Last year's protests reflected popular disenchantment with established political parties, which are again seeking power.

item.title: Asia’s stock markets plunge amid US-Israeli conflict with Iran
item.description: Asian stocks rack up steep losses after Wall Street shrugs off risks of widening conflict.

item.title: Israel strikes Lebanon’s Beirut again; Hezbollah launches drones at Israel
item.description: The Israeli army says it is striking Hezbollah targets as its raids cause mass displacement in Lebanon.

item.title: What we know on day four of US-Israeli attacks on Iran
item.description: Washington says 'harder hits' are still to come, as Tehran retaliates by closing the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: How Russia could benefit from the US-Israeli war on Iran
item.description: A protracted conflict in the Middle East could help Russia's war effort in Ukraine.
